title: ledum subulatum
intro: Ledum subulatum, commonly known as the dwarf cinquefoil or round-leaved cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species in the heath family (Ericaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the treatment of diarrhea, fever, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ledum subulatum include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve digestion, and reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
